_description: Experiment definitions for run_experiments.py. Each experiment is a set of dotted-path overrides applied on top of base_config. Stage 2 (train) + stage 3 (env backtest) always run; stage 4 (backtrader) runs only with --with-backtrader. Results are collected into experiments_results.csv and ranked by env_sharpe_minus_eqw.
_notes: Override keys are dotted paths into config.json (e.g. 'models.ppo.model_kwargs.gamma'). Set a value to null to null-out a key (e.g. policy_kwargs -> default MLP). The 'grid' block expands the cartesian product of its 'axes' into one experiment per combination, named name_prefix + '_' + leafkey+value per axis. Experiments whose overrides touch data ('data.*', 'benchmark.*', 'cash.*') get their own stage-1 data run; all others reuse the shared data/ produced once. Add/remove experiments freely - already-completed ones (present in experiments_results.csv with status=ok) are skipped unless --force.
